text:
maria: Quick sync — finalizing DP beta recruitment + feedback ops. Goal: 20 partners across 2 staggered cohorts, 4-week pilot each. Need: intake form, screening rubric, compensation tiers, onboarding runbook, and metrics dashboard. Who can take which items? :spiral_calendar:

devin: I can own onboarding/runbook + ops runbook. FYI capacity: we can support 6 concurrent partners out of the box; with light automation (~templates + scripts) scale to 12. For 20 we'll do staggered starts and a small ops on-call rota. Need clarity on SSO/infra requirements per partner.

sam: UX will produce two short templates: 1) product usability tasks, 2) prompt-quality checklist. Recommend weekly 15m live sync + 10m recorded demo Looms. Keep surveys to 4-6 questions max.

ashok: CS acceptance signals: at least 70% weekly active usage, one primary feature used by >=20% of partner flows, and partner-reported blocker response <=48h. We'll capture issues in shared tracker (Jira board). Refund/credit terms if core SLA missed.

juno: Proposed intake form (minimal to reduce friction):
```
- org_name
- contact_name + email + timezone
- company_size
- primary_use_case (1-2 sentences)
- expected_monthly_tokens (est)
- data_sensitivity: public | internal | regulated
- sso_required: yes/no
- want_co-marketing: yes/no
- nda_agree: checkbox
```

maria: Compensation tiers idea: Tier A (early adopters): $5k credits + co-marketing; Tier B (pilot): 50% discount for 3 months; Tier C (observational): free credits only. Legal: keep to an NDA + short pilot terms doc. No MSA initially.

devin: Operations note: require a canary policy for infra/model changes during pilot. If partner evals show >5% quality regression, pause rollout for affected partners and trigger incident ladder. Reserve "rescue" capacity for degraded cases. Also need a simple health-check script partners can run.

sam: Feedback loop proposal: weekly automated eval against partner prompt set (run by infra), Notion scoreboard for each partner (latency p50/p95, error rate, quality delta), single weekly digest email to partner + internal thread. Capture free-text anecdotes in a shared doc.

ashok: Success checklist (suggested): onboarding complete <=5 business days, latency p50 <200ms, error rate <1%, NPS >=8 at week 4, feature adoption >=20% of tracked flows. If any metric fails by week 6, we offer remediation plan or partial credit.

maria: Screening rubric draft: prioritize diversity of use-cases + realistic volume. Must include at least one regulated-sensitivity partner to validate Private deployment onboarding. Keep cohort balanced across org size.

juno: Outreach copy: short, human, call-to-action + link to intake form. Offer flexible start dates and list of support touchpoints.

maria: Next steps: @devin - onboarding + runbook draft by Tue COB; @sam - feedback templates + scoreboard skeleton by Wed; @ashok - SLA + compensation terms draft by Fri; @juno - intake form + outreach copy by Mon EOD. I'll assemble screening rubric and outreach list.

feedback-bot: Assigned to project 'dp-recruitment'. Deadlines added to project board.

maria: Thanks — will run a 30m alignment Tue 10am if drafts look good. :rocket:
